items.title_fr: Pokémon Teams Up With Casetify On A New Line Of Phone Cases And Accessories
items.summary_fr: Launching next week. The Pokémon Company really is going all out with the collaborations for its 30th anniversary. Phone case brand Casetify is next in line for a crossover, as it has announced that its new collection of cases and accessories will be launching next week.

items.title_fr: Tiny Bookshop Sells 1 Million Copies, New DLC Expansion Announced
items.summary_fr: Launching next month. Tiny Bookshop , the charming indie title in which you take on the role of bookseller in a quaint seaside resort, has officially sold surpassed 1 million copies sold across PC, Switch, PS5, Xbox, iOS, and Android since its launch in August 2025. To celebrate, publisher Skystone Games and developer neoludic have announced a new DLC expansion launching on 5th December 2026 : Arts & Crafts.

items.title_fr: UK Charts: No Disc, No Problem - GTA 6 Shoves Zelda Further Down The Ranking
items.summary_fr: Disc/Reward. The latest physical sales chart for the UK is in, and in perhaps the most unsurprising bit of news in yonks , Grand Theft Auto 6 is quite the hit. Yes, the lack of a disc in the game's 'physical' release wasn't enough of a deterrent for many picking up Rockstar's latest, as it snatched up first place in its debut week.
